# Helvety PDF

> Helvety PDF merges, reorders, rotates, and extracts pages in the tab. Add images where supported. Work stays in the browser and is not sent to a conversion API. AGPL-3.0-licensed open source, Swiss-built.

## Canonical URL
- [Helvety PDF](https://helvety.com/pdf): Main PDF application route

## Crawling And Indexing
- The public PDF application route is intended to be crawlable and indexable.

## Related Helvety Apps
- [Helvety](https://helvety.com)
- [Helvety Store](https://helvety.com/store)
- [Helvety Image Upscaler](https://helvety.com/image-upscaler)
- [Helvety Auth](https://helvety.com/auth)
- [Helvety Contacts](https://helvety.com/contacts)
- [Helvety Notes](https://helvety.com/notes)
- [Helvety Tasks](https://helvety.com/tasks)

## Licensing
All Helvety products with published source are released under AGPL-3.0 or later (including browser extensions, SharePoint solutions, and desktop tools distributed outside this repository).
